mapper.sql: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspace_members actor ON actor.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND actor.member_id = #{memberId} AND actor.status = 0 AND ((actor.role = 70 AND (n.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = n.project_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND p.deleted IS NULL))) OR (n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN project_members own ON own.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.project_id = n.project_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND p.deleted IS NULL AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND own.role = 50 AND own.status = 0)))
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM notice n WHERE n.deleted IS NULL

SELECT n.notice_id, n.workspace_id, n.project_id, md.name AS member_name, n.task_id, n.member_id, n.notice_type, n.title, n.status, n.view_count, n.created, (SELECT COUNT(notice_file_id) FROM notice_files f WHERE f.notice_id = n.notice_id) AS file_count FROM notice n LEFT JOIN member_details md ON n.member_id = md.member_id WHERE n.deleted IS NULL
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT n.notice_id, n.workspace_id, n.project_id, n.task_id, n.member_id, n.notice_type, n.title, n.content, n.created, n.updated, n.status, n.view_count, f.notice_file_id, f.file_size, f.original_name, f.stored_name, f.file_path, f.uploaded FROM notice n LEFT JOIN notice_files f ON n.notice_id = f.notice_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_notice.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO notice (notice_id, notice_type, workspace_id, project_id, task_id, member_id, title, content, status, view_count, created) VALUES (#{notice_id}, #{notice_type}, #{workspace_id}, #{project_id}, #{task_id}, #{member_id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, 0, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO notice_files (notice_file_id, notice_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded) VALUES (seq_notice_files.NEXTVAL, #{notice_id}, #{original_name}, #{stored_name}, #{file_path}, #{file_size}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE notice n SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, updated = SYSDATE WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.member_id = #{member_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members actor WHERE actor.member_id = #{member_id} AND actor.status = 0 AND ((n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.workspace_id = actor.workspace_id AND actor.role = 70) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = n.project_id AND p.workspace_id = actor.workspace_id AND p.deleted IS NULL AND (actor.role = 70 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_members own WHERE own.project_id = p.project_id AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND own.status = 0 AND own.role = 50)))))

UPDATE notice n SET deleted = SYSDATE WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members actor WHERE actor.member_id = #{requester_member_id} AND actor.status = 0 AND ((n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.workspace_id = actor.workspace_id AND actor.role = 70) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = n.project_id AND p.workspace_id = actor.workspace_id AND p.deleted IS NULL AND (actor.role = 70 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_members own WHERE own.project_id = p.project_id AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND own.status = 0 AND own.role = 50)))))
